scientific_integrity: Analytical scalar norm comparison and compactness on the two-dimensional scalar sphere; finite diagnostics are checks, not a proof. Exact equality and near-equality claims independently proved and compared with closely related prior matrix norm theorems.
scientific_limitations: Real Lp only; qualitative uniform near-equality modulus without an optimal explicit rate for general p; quartic defect restricted to Euclidean-balanced scalar coefficients; p=1,infinity equality cases not classified; background sharp constant is a known implication of matrix norm methods; publication priority is not certified.
title: Uniform rigidity of skew-min extremizers in real \(L^p\)
